metadata.mechanics: After at least 10 Minutes of Active Roleplay regarding the necessity to inflict violence over all others, up to 10 Targeted participants gain "Upsurge: May expend First Aid or Biogenetics to replace a single use of Break or Ground & Pound". They may not gain uses of Break or Ground & Pound unless they already possess those skills.
metadata.requirementsToUse: Lore: Faith - Common OR Profession Saint. Must be Inducted to Kings and Queens Court
metadata.validTargetDescription: Self and 1+ Target(s) Inducted into Kings and Queens Court.
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: Many of the Kings and Queens of old knew that sometimes violence is the answer. You stood up against oppression, you fought for justice, you got back up when you were knocked down, and you broke the systems that oppressed you. This Benediction starts simple with the user calling for the pit to be opened, cutting their hand and then starting a steady beat for the others to hear. Each participant, in turn, then adds to the beat with either additional strength, voices, singing, dancing, or screaming. As the Benediction continues it gets faster, harder, and louder until it becomes a cacophony of voices and adrenaline. The Benediction ends in a unified scream.
